digest.component_or_area: codebase quality remediation (CI, docs, module structure, graph complexity, typing)
propositions: Python 3.11 xdist worker test failures in test_opcert_service_app indicate CI suite reliability flake
User-facing documentation example for assignee field teaches Jira-unresolvable identity inconsistent with docs/config.md
Three near-cap modules (structured_run.py, compact.py, event_append.py) exceed or approach 800-LOC cap due to flat units mixing responsibilities without clear layering
Graph traversal subsystem (_blockers, _compute_dep_graph, and related functions) exhibits high cyclomatic complexity (CCN) with duplicated loader and BFS infrastructure across call-sites
attest package contains untyped function definitions failing mypy --disallow-untyped-defs
Ratchet-enforced caps (800 LOC, CCN thresholds) suppress symptoms but do not prevent structural creep; decomposition by responsibility and centralized infrastructure are required to avoid recurrence
